commitResults.messageBody: Introduce TaskList as the owner of Crystal's mutable task collection. Encapsulate add, delete, lookup, count, and date-filter operations, and expose immutable list snapshots for persistence. Adapt Crystal to delegate collection work while preserving existing console and storage behavior. Also align stale UI test expectations from the Level-8 merge with the application's current wording and record the passing regression session.

Introduce Ui as the single owner of standard input, console formatting, and user-facing responses. Move the startup banner, command prompt, dividers, task-list rendering, mutation confirmations, errors, and farewell out of Crystal. Adapt Crystal to coordinate task and storage decisions through Ui methods while preserving the exact console contract verified by all 12 Java 25 UI regression cases.

Introduce Parser as the single owner of command recognition and argument validation. Move list and date parsing, task-number conversion, and todo/deadline/event construction out of Crystal, and reduce CommandType to command metadata. Use Optional to distinguish a plain list request from a date-filtered list without null ambiguity, while keeping command execution in Crystal and preserving every existing user-facing error and response.

commitResults.messageTitle: Align exit command type with command hierarchy
commitResults.messageBody: Rename the internal CommandType.BYE value to CommandType.EXIT while retaining bye as the user-facing keyword. Update Parser and Crystal references so the enum describes the command's application action and maps naturally to the planned ExitCommand class. Preserve all console and persistence behavior as verified by the complete Java 25 UI regression suite.

Give Crystal explicit Ui, Storage, and TaskList state and move the command loop into run(). Convert Storage from a static utility into an instance backed by a configurable Path, while retaining an OS-independent relative data path in main. Preserve startup ordering, missing-directory handling, corruption recovery, and all existing persistence behavior in preparation for passing these dependencies to Command.execute.

commitResults.messageTitle: Introduce command abstraction for task additions
commitResults.messageBody: Add an abstract Command contract with execute and default non-exit behavior. Extract AddCommand to own task insertion, persistence, and confirmation, and update Parser to construct the command after validating todo, deadline, or event input. Keep the remaining command families in Crystal so this first polymorphic path can be verified independently.

Add TaskIndexCommand to centralize execution-time task-index validation, then extract MarkCommand, UnmarkCommand, and DeleteCommand with their status rules, persistence, and UI responses. Update Parser to construct mutation commands without depending on TaskList state and reduce Crystal to executing the returned command for all indexed mutations.

Extract ListCommand for full and date-filtered views and ExitCommand for farewell and session termination. Add Parser.parse as the sole public parsing entry point that returns concrete Command objects, and replace Crystal's command-type switch with polymorphic execute and isExit calls inside a try-catch-finally loop. Move divider ownership to the loop while preserving exact output for successful, invalid, and exit commands.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add parser and exception unit tests

Exercise every concrete command's mutation, persistence, output, no-op, read-only, invalid-index, and exit behavior with isolated console and temporary storage fixtures.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add UI and application loop unit tests
commitResults.messageBody: Assert console input and every meaningful UI response variant, then verify Crystal startup loading, command-loop recovery, persistence, corrupted-file replacement, and orderly exit with isolated streams and files.

commitResults.messageBody: Document package-mirrored unit test conventions and normal, boundary, and error coverage. Update the test-ui workflow to run the Java 25 Gradle test suite before exact console regression tests.
